pages.text: The furnace is a stack of $(item)3x3 layers$(), from $(item)3 up to 10$() layers high (server setting blastFurnaceMaxHeight).
$(l)Every layer$()$(li)The $(item)4 corners$(): Fireproof Brick Reinforcement.$(li)The $(item)4 edge middles$(): Fireproof Bricks.$(li)The $(item)centre$(): empty air.
$(l)The bottom layer$()$(li)Its $(item)centre$() is a block of $(item)Fireproof Bricks$(): the floor of the shaft.$(li)One edge brick is replaced by the $(item)Blast Furnace Output$().
The furnace counts layers from the bottom and stops at the first one that is wrong, so a mistake on layer 4 gives you a 3-layer furnace. Below 3 complete layers it does nothing.

The view shows the smallest furnace: 3 layers, the output on the south side, a hot air hatch on the west wall and a gas hatch on top. It takes 12 reinforcements, 11 fireproof bricks, the output and 2 hatches.
